entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: No matter what happens, we[n]have to change her heart.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We may all have our own[n]unique way of doing things...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But we should just[n]proceed forward as usual.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm honestly not sure I'll be[n]able to remain calm this time...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's why I ask that you[n]lend me your help.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's no need to get too worked up[n]about this, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Take as much time as you need to get[n]ready. Anything goes as long as it helps[n]out our mission.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You have our trust. You're our leader,[n]after all.
